_source: OSRS Wiki: Pharaoh's_sceptre (teleports, charges, recharging, diary capacities) and Transcript:Guardian_mummy (the recharge talk, in npc-dialogues.json). Ids are cache gamevals; the artefacts and their materials come from plugins/minigames/pyramidplunder/data/pyramid-plunder.json.
_capacity: Charges held: 3 by default, more with each Desert Diary tier (Wiki).
_cost: Artefacts of one material for a full recharge, noted ones too (Wiki).
_destinations: In the order of the sceptre's options; tiles are the Wiki's map pins (walkable). Jalsavrah is the default for Last-Teleport before any teleport (Wiki).

messages.prompt: Where would you like to teleport to?
messages.empty: Your sceptre has run out of charges.
messages.noCharges: Your sceptre has no charges left. The guardian mummy in Jalsavrah can recharge it.
messages.checkEmpty: Your sceptre has no charges left.
messages.uncharged: You remove the charges from your sceptre.
messages.unchargeConfirm: Uncharge the sceptre? Its {charges} charge{s} will be lost.
messages.needNecropolis: You must commune with the obelisk in the Necropolis before you can teleport there.
messages.communed: The obelisk attunes itself to your sceptre.
messages._unverified: every message here has no capture behind it; the Wiki gives none for the sceptre itself
